    • Key Achievements: 2025 U.S. Amateur Champion, 2025 Walker Cup competitor.

    Mason Howell, the 2025 U.S. Amateur champion and 2026 Masters competitor, is set to attend the University of Georgia (UGA). He is scheduled to enroll as a freshman and join the Georgia Bulldogs golf team in the fall of 2026. 
    • Commitment: Howell announced his commitment to UGA in September 2024.
    • Background: A Georgia native, he is a standout junior golfer from the Brookwood School.
    • Future Plans: He intends to play collegiate golf under Coach Haack and potentially major in financial planning.

      Reigning U.S. Amateur winner Mason Howell is in the Masters field this week. As Golf Digest's @RHerringtonGD reported, the 18-year-old is a walking billboard at Augusta National thanks to NIL. Howell, who is headed to Georgia next fall, partnered with Shake Shack ahead of this week, and will sport the burger chain's logo on his left sleeve. He's also sponsored by Huntington Bank as well as the global law firm Eversheds Sutherland. As for that logo on his shirt collar, that's the logo for "The Rose," a brand new private club 15 minutes from UGA's Athens campus that Howell and his Bulldog teammates will practice at next season. The course opened for play to its members just a few weeks ago. Founding members include UGA alum Bubba Watson, Chris Kirk and Brendon Todd, as well as Super Bowl champ and former Dawg Matthew Stafford and Georgia football coach Kirby Smart.
